items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Hewett Abner (PHONETIC) connected with VeeJay then? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: That was all the go then. They'd record his back beat. Then it'd all depend on how many men they needed for the session. He'd hire extra men.
